milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate forward from spawn to the dirt patch at Z=3-7. With max_distance=4, player must actually walk onto or very near the dirt patch (5 blocks from spawn) rather than observing it from spawn. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures player is looking at the dirt.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate past the dirt patch to the birch grove at Z=8-9. With max_distance=5, player must be within the grove area (~8.6 blocks from spawn) and facing a birch log.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must approach the decorated structure to the left and face the purple stained glass windows on the east wall (~6.2 blocks from spawn). With max_distance=5, player must walk toward the structure entrance. This is an independent root branch.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must cross the water to reach the mushroom island platform (mycelium at X=8-12, Z=10-14, ~15.6 blocks from spawn). With max_distance=6, player must be on or very near the island, not just viewing it from shore.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate to the water edge near the mushroom island and look toward the waterlogged tube coral at the water surface (Y=-1). With max_distance=5, player must be at the water's edge or in the water near the coral.

Uses inventory_has because mining basalt with a pickaxe drops basalt as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe and basalt is on the far side of the mushroom island at X=12-14, Z=13-15, Y=-1 to Y=1.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must enter the structure through the doorway and navigate to the blue carpet corridor inside (~8.1 blocks from spawn). With max_distance=4, player must be inside the structure standing near the carpet.

Uses inventory_has because mining magenta concrete with a pickaxe drops magenta_concrete as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The magenta concrete forms exterior walls at Z=0 and X=-13 adjacent to the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate through the structure past the blue carpet corridor, through the interior wall opening at X=-9, into the back room where lime wool is placed (~12.5 blocks from spawn). With max_distance=4, player must be in the back room.

Uses inventory_has because mining orange concrete powder drops it as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The powder is at Y=-2 beneath the basalt layer at X=12-14, Z=13-15; player must mine through basalt first to expose it.

Uses inventory_has because crafting paper (from 3 sugar cane in a horizontal row) produces paper items that appear in the player's inventory. Player must harvest sugar cane from near the birch trees, place the crafting table, and craft. Paper is not in starting inventory so any paper confirms successful crafting.
